description: The recorded env variables of a test unit that its test process gets at run time (Cargo's fill_env), plus CARGO_BIN_EXE_*, which Cargo also sets on test processes (cargo 0.97.0, ops/cargo_test.rs: the unit_output env from artifact::get_env; assert_cmd reads it at run time). The others (CARGO_CRATE_NAME, OUT_DIR, CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR, ...) are compile-time only. Read by breakbulk-instantiate (dynamic.rs, is_runtime_var) and by the Nix library (lib/test-runs.nix, isRuntimeVar): one list for both delivery modes.
